mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_baby_info (email, baby_name, birth_date, gender, profile_image_file_name, blood_type, birth_week_count) VALUES (#{email}, #{babyName}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{profileImageFileName}, #{bloodType}, #{birthWeekCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_baby_info SET baby_name = #{babyName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, profile_image_file_name = #{profileImageFileName}, blood_type = #{bloodType}, birth_week_count = #{birthWeekCount} WHERE baby_no = #{babyNo};
